## T005

- Date: 1934-10-09
- Place: Marseille, France
- Region: Europe
- Theme: laws and treaties
- Status: `we-have-a-record`

Citation: [LON-1937-LOC](../sources/regions/europe.md#LON-1937-LOC) ([https://www.loc.gov/item/2021667893/](https://www.loc.gov/item/2021667893/))

- Date: 1937-11-16
- Place: Geneva, Switzerland
- Region: Europe
- Theme: laws and treaties
- Status: `we-have-a-record`

<a id="T133"></a>
## T133

- Date: 1898-11
- Place: Rome, Italy
- Region: Europe
- Theme: studies and evaluations
- Status: `we-have-a-record`

An international anti-anarchist conference met in Rome in November and December 1898; the historian Richard Bach Jensen describes it as the first international gathering convened to combat terrorism.

Citations:

- [HIST-ROME1898-JENSEN](../sources/regions/europe.md#HIST-ROME1898-JENSEN) ([https://cat-int.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Terrorism-and-Political-ViolenceThe-International-Campaign-Against-Anarchist-Terrorism-1880%E2%80%931930s-Richard-Bach-Jensen-Vol.21-Issue-1-2009.pdf](https://cat-int.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Terrorism-and-Political-ViolenceThe-International-Campaign-Against-Anarchist-Terrorism-1880%E2%80%931930s-Richard-Bach-Jensen-Vol.21-Issue-1-2009.pdf))
- [HIST-ROME1898-JCH](../sources/regions/europe.md#HIST-ROME1898-JCH) ([https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/002200948101600205](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/002200948101600205))

<a id="T134"></a>
## T134

- Date: 1904-03-14
- Place: \[UNKNOWN\] (known as the St. Petersburg Protocol)
- Region: Europe
- Theme: laws and treaties
- Status: `we-have-a-record`

A secret anti-anarchist protocol was signed by Russia, Germany, Austria-Hungary and other states; the 1918 published text is dated 1/14 March 1904 (Julian/Gregorian), and Jensen gives 14 March 1904.

Citations:

- [HIST-ROME1898-JENSEN](../sources/regions/europe.md#HIST-ROME1898-JENSEN) ([https://cat-int.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Terrorism-and-Political-ViolenceThe-International-Campaign-Against-Anarchist-Terrorism-1880%E2%80%931930s-Richard-Bach-Jensen-Vol.21-Issue-1-2009.pdf](https://cat-int.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Terrorism-and-Political-ViolenceThe-International-Campaign-Against-Anarchist-Terrorism-1880%E2%80%931930s-Richard-Bach-Jensen-Vol.21-Issue-1-2009.pdf))
